description: Sputnik X EU trade intelligence — query 67.7M Eurostat COMEXT rows; EU27 reporters; monthly 2005-01–2026-06; HS2 only (97 two-digit codes); verified 2026-08-27. Query types: overview, countries, timeline, top_partners, top_products, balance, heatmap, macro_context (current global ECB/FRED snapshot). Supported filters depend on the REST view. EU-wide CN8 must not be inferred; see https://sputnikx.xyz/.well-known/data-coverage.json.

response_format.description: Response detail level: "concise" (default, key fields only) or "detailed" (all fields)
